descriptions: This dataset contains 31 audio recordings (18 items) on the subjects of mainstream Islam, liberal Islam and Islamists in Egypt.
Interviews in this dataset were conducted in English, German, and Arabic. Summary translations and metadata for all recordings are provided in English.
